name: Winds in the Desert
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?

The last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?

I gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hey, now isn't that just the thing! You've got our supplies back for us. That's great. I'll be able to get back to work just as soon as I can find someone to haul these sacks for me.
narrative.requestItemsText: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 9 to 11, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Winds in the Desert
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Securing the Lines
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
